meta.title: CDR Banking & Energy Test Data -- Master Schema Catalog
meta.description: Consolidated schema catalog for all 18 entity types in the Australian Consumer Data Right (CDR) test data set. Each entity includes a data contract (field types, formats, constraints, required fields) and 2 real sample records extracted from the generated output files.
